reference_source: NIDDK - National Institute of Diabetes and Digestive and Kidney Diseases; MedlinePlus
notes: Dataset feature names are provisional mappings to medical symptoms. polyuria maps to frequent urination; excessive_hunger maps to increased hunger; blurred_and_distorted_vision maps to blurred vision. Weight loss can be associated particularly with type 1 diabetes. Increased thirst, numbness or tingling, and slow-healing sores are not represented by exact matching features in this dataset. This reference does not establish every possible symptom combination as medically valid. Structural validation is not medical validation.
